// A fixed pool of particles in typed arrays: position, velocity, life and
// hue, in cell units. A dead one is replaced by the last, so the live ones
// are always the first `count`.
export class Particles {
  x: Float32Array
  y: Float32Array
  vx: Float32Array
  vy: Float32Array
  life: Float32Array
  hue: Uint8Array
  kind: Uint8Array
  count = 0
  max: number

  constructor(max: number) {
    this.max = max
    this.x = new Float32Array(max)
    this.y = new Float32Array(max)
    this.vx = new Float32Array(max)
    this.vy = new Float32Array(max)
    this.life = new Float32Array(max)
    this.hue = new Uint8Array(max)
    this.kind = new Uint8Array(max)
  }

  add(x: number, y: number, vx: number, vy: number, life: number, hue: number, kind = 0): boolean {
    if (this.count >= this.max) return false
    const i = this.count++
    this.x[i] = x
    this.y[i] = y
    this.vx[i] = vx
    this.vy[i] = vy
    this.life[i] = life
    this.hue[i] = hue
    this.kind[i] = kind
    return true
  }

  remove(i: number) {
    const last = --this.count
    this.x[i] = this.x[last]
    this.y[i] = this.y[last]
    this.vx[i] = this.vx[last]
    this.vy[i] = this.vy[last]
    this.life[i] = this.life[last]
    this.hue[i] = this.hue[last]
    this.kind[i] = this.kind[last]
  }
}
